pages.text: When the river rose, its water turned muddy yellow. They collected it in a jar. Once the soil settled, the water at the top cleared.
Mina sat before the jar with a dipper. "I'll scoop water for the pots first!"
The water was still cloudy. Mina stared inside.
Mina put in a finger and stirred, round and round.
Settled soil floated up again. The whole jar grew cloudy.
Raju brought a dipper, then put it back. "Now we have to wait again."
None of the three could scoop water. Mina waited longest.
Mom put the lid on. "Water clears by itself when you leave it alone."
Mina sat with both hands on their knees, only watching the jar.
When the lid opened, the water on top was clear. Mina took the first dipperful.
